test_policy.notes: UC Davis no longer considers SAT or ACT scores for admission decisions or scholarship awards.

requirements.notes: Fee is $80 per campus, $95 for international applicants; fee waivers cover up to four campuses but only for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and AB540-eligible applicants. UC does not require or read letters of recommendation at application. The 4 Personal Insight Questions are the only essays (no campus supplement).

deadlines.label: UC application filing period closes
deadlines.note: Admission decisions released March 1-31, 2027 (some campuses earlier)
deadlines.notes: No early plans. Application opens August 1, 2026 for fall 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if you studied in the U.S. fewer than three years and received instruction in a language other than English before that. UC Davis lists TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, certain AP/IB exams or transferable college English coursework; minimums are the UC-wide ones. UC notes Davis, UCLA and Santa Barbara may require additional English testing after admission.

english.notes: Tests taken January 2026 or later (1-6 scale).
IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted.

aid.notes: UC Davis financial aid says international students may be eligible for scholarships, private loans and short-term loans, and links to institutional/prestigious scholarships and outside scholarships; it does not describe a need-based program for internationals.

tier_notes.business: No business administration major (Managerial Economics is the closest option).
tier_notes.nursing: No undergraduate nursing (Betty Irene Moore School of Nursing is graduate-only).
